headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 26, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Cleveland Guardians 1-0, with Drew Rasmussen pitching 7.0 innings of shutout ball. Cedric Mullins led the Rays' offense with a single, RBI, and 3 at-bats. In other action, the Washington Nationals secured a 10-7 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams going 3 for 5 with 2 home runs and 3 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates also pulled off a thrilling comeback, defeating the Chicago Cubs 8-7 behind a home run and 4 RBIs from Ryan O'Hearn.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Cody Bellinger, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. The New York Yankees left fielder is expected to miss time. Other notable injuries include Shea Langeliers, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a torn meniscus in his right knee, and Josh Jung, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a left calf strain.

The St. Louis Cardinals made a midseason trade, sending RHP Scott Blewett to the Athletics for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates also made a trade, sending RHP José Urquidy to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Felix Doroteo. Additionally, the Boston Red Sox traded LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals for 3B Curtis Mead, and the Philadelphia Phillies acquired CF Kameron Misner from the Kansas City Royals for cash.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Guardians in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Cleveland Guardians 1-0, with Drew Rasmussen pitching 7.0 innings of shutout ball, striking out 9 and walking 1. Cedric Mullins led the Rays' offense with a single, RBI, and 3 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 10-7**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 7-10 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the charge at the plate. Abrams went 3 for 5 with 2 home runs and 3 RBIs, while Max Kranick pitched a strong 1.0 inning in relief.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Chicago Cubs 8-7 in a closely contested matchup. Ryan O'Hearn led the Pirates' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Rout Blue Jays 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, winning 6-1 behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Jarren Duran led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Bellinger Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: New York Yankees left fielder Cody Bellinger has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. The injury occurred on July 26, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Make Midseason Trade**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals traded RHP Scott Blewett to the Athletics for cash on July 26, 2026.
